title: Dual Ended Transition Blush Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A dual-ended brush designed to softly diffuse liquid and powder-transition blush formulas for a seamless, airbrushed look.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Sheer

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: The smaller end of the brush has a dome shape with softly packed bristles that blend Liquid Transition Brightening Blush (sold separately) into the under-eye area. The larger, fluffy end features dual-fiber bristles that evenly diffuse Transition Blurring Blush Duo powders (sold separately).
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Before Blush: Use the smaller, domed end of the brush to blend Liquid Brightening Transition Blush into Major Skin Soft Blur Brightening Concealer (each sold separately).
-Apply with pressing motions to the under-eye area.
-After Blush: Use the larger, fluffy end of the brush to sweep the Transition Blurring Blush Duo between the apples of the cheeks and the under-eyes for a seamlessly blurred finish.
